confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Yogyakarta's tourist price levels for a July 2026 window, which is a peak travel period. No menus, listings, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and budget-accommodation anchors are moderately reliable; the three-star hotel rate is the least certain because of seasonal swings. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to local beer pricing because direct knowledge is weaker and alcohol prices vary widely by venue.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was supplied. The basis is Yogyakarta's own budget-to-mid-range tourism pricing, placed among Indonesia's mid-sized heritage tourist cities and below Bali's resort pricing.

anchor_basis.beer: Bintang lager, one 330 ml serving at a casual restaurant (draft is uncommon), about 40,000 IDR
anchor_basis.coffee: Cappuccino at a tourist-area cafe, about 30,000 IDR
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: Nasi goreng or gudeg main at a budget restaurant, about 35,000 IDR
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: Three-course dinner for two, no drinks, at a mid-range restaurant, about 350,000 IDR
anchor_basis.cocktail: Standard cocktail at a bar, about 75,000 IDR, set relative to beer pricing
anchor_basis.wine_glass: Glass of wine at a mid-range restaurant, about 100,000 IDR, set relative to beer pricing
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: Dorm bed in a registered hostel in Prawirotaman or Sosrowijayan, about 110,000 IDR per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: Private double room in a budget hostel, about 300,000 IDR per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: Basic guesthouse (losmen) double room, about 200,000 IDR per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: Standard double room at a registered three-star hotel, about 650,000 IDR per night
